item.title: iFLYTEK Healthcare Upgrades Spark Medical Model to V3.7 and Reports 99.6 on MedBench 5.0
item.description: iFLYTEK Healthcare upgraded its Spark medical model to V3.7, merging speech, imaging and language for medical agents. The company says it scored 99.6 on Shanghai AI Lab's MedBench 5.0.

item.title: Huawei Upgrades Celia With Save-Anything Notes and Proactive Suggestions in More Than 100 Apps
item.description: Huawei upgraded two Celia features: one saves and summarizes content from any app, and one proactively suggests form fills and follow-up questions. More than 100 apps now support them.

item.title: OpenAnolis Builds Anolis OS 27 Agent-Native as Alibaba Cloud Says Agents Write 95% of New Code
item.description: At GOSIM in Zhuhai, OpenAnolis chair Ma Tao said Anolis OS 27 is being built agent-native and that agents now write 95% of new code in Alibaba Cloud's basic software team.

item.title: Hikrobot Launches Single-Unit Smart Mobile Robots That Deploy in 30 Minutes Without a Server
item.description: Hikrobot launched a new self-contained mobile robot series that needs no server or site changes. It also upgraded its tote storage and picking system, which reaches up to 900 picks per hour.

item.title: Dawa Technology's Scenes AI Runs a 34B Real-Time World Model at 720p and 25fps on One RTX GPU
item.description: Chongqing-based Dawa Technology's Scenes AI updates a persistent world state from a normal camera feed. It runs a 34B sparse model at 720p and 25fps on a single consumer RTX card.
